notFound: Miele: miele.co.uk refused every request (HTTP 403 "requested URL was rejected" to both curl and the page reader), so Miele models were read from Appliance City's own listing pages instead, and only its 8 washing machines and the first 12 of its 21 Miele dishwashers were read.
Miele tumble dryers and washer dryers: no listing page was read for them (miele.co.uk refused and the fetch budget ran out before an Appliance City page for them), so none are recorded.

AEG: aeg.co.uk refused every request (connection errors from curl, HTTP 503 from the page reader), so AEG models come only from page 1 of 3 of Appliance City's AEG laundry listing (12 of 25 items); AEG dishwashers and the other 13 laundry items were not read.

Zanussi: zanussi.co.uk refused the connection in the same way as aeg.co.uk, and no retailer listing carrying Zanussi could be read (Appliance City's brand list does not include it, AO.com and Currys answered with Cloudflare 403, John Lewis refused the connection, and the two Marks Electrical Zanussi pages tried returned no products), so no Zanussi models are recorded.

Electrolux: no models are recorded because electrolux.co.uk was not fetched after the other Electrolux Group sites (aeg.co.uk, zanussi.co.uk) refused, and no reachable retailer listing carried the brand (Appliance City does not list it and Appliances Direct's Electrolux washing machine listing returned no products).
Neff laundry: neff-home.com/uk lists the washer dryers V8540X0GB, V8340X0GB and VNA341U8GB and the built-in washing machines W544BX2GB and W543BX2GB with no price, so they are left out.

Neff dishwashers: the maker's own dishwasher listing was not fetched (its laundry listing showed no prices at all), so the 11 Neff dishwashers recorded come from Appliance City's Neff dishwasher listing.
Bosch: the shop lists the built-in washing machines WIW28302GB and WIW28502GB and the built-in dishwashers SBH4HVX14G, SMD6ZCX61G and SMD6ZCX60G with no price, so they are left out.

Bosch: its shop listing pages show only the first 12 items and the extra pages load by script, so one front-loading washing machine (11 counted, 10 shown), two freestanding dishwashers (14 counted, 12 shown) and two built-in dishwashers (14 counted, 12 shown) were not read.
Siemens: the UK site has no shop and shows only recommended retail prices, so every Siemens price recorded is that RRP.

Siemens: the listing shows no price for the tumble dryers WQ46H2D9IE and WQ45G200GB, the washer dryers WK14D260GB and WN34A1U8GB, and the dishwashers SN61HX00KG, SN61HX02TG, SN95ZX62CG, SN97TX02CE, SR93EX25MG and SX73HX03VG, so they are left out.
Siemens: the first page of the dishwasher listing showed 12 of 24 items, so a few built-in dishwashers on the unread second page may be missing.
EPREL numbers: none of the pages read (Bosch, Siemens, Neff, Smeg shop, Appliance City) shows an EPREL number or an eprel.ec.europa.eu link, so eprel is null for every model.

Widths of washing machines, tumble dryers and washer dryers, place settings of dishwashers and model years are not stated on any page read, so those fields are null (widthCm is set only for dishwashers whose listing text states 45 cm or 60 cm).

Load type and fuel: only Bosch and Siemens say "front loader" and no page states a dryer's fuel, so loadType is filled as front for every washer and washer dryer listed (none was a top loader) and fuel as electric for every dryer, while dryerType is set only where the page says heat pump (Bosch, Siemens and Appliance City's AEG dryers) and is null for Smeg's two dryers.

Smeg: the maker's UK shop is shop.smeguk.com, which was read as collection data in place of smeg.co.uk (not fetched), and it lists WHT814LUK and WMFABCR-2 with a price of 0.00, so those two are left out.
Smeg: the shop labels the WMFABBL-2 variant "White" although its model number reads as black, so no colour is recorded for it.

Appliance City showed Neff S155HVX00G, S175HTX06G, S187ZCX03G and S875HKX21G, Miele WED385WCS, WEE385WCS and G7080 SCVI, and AEG TR719A4B, LFED61844B and TR948V4BC as out of stock while still listing a price, so they are recorded as current models that may be running out.

Appliance City prices are that retailer's own listed prices (no struck-through regular price was shown on any card read), and Miele and AEG model numbers are copied as that retailer writes them, including the spaces in Miele's G5651 VI, G5851 SCVI, G7080 SCVI and G7085 SCVI XXL.
